meta.currency: 100 copper (cp) = 1 silver (sp); 100 sp = 1 gold (gp). Prices are stored in copper.
notes: No in-game auction house exists, so there is no complete or official price feed. Every row is a single dated observation from the named source.
Patch 0.30.2.9 (Oct 15, 2026) rebalanced coin drops across many NPC types and added sellable medallion drops. Vendor values recorded before then may be stale.

mmwiki-lv.name: monstersandmemories.wiki - Loot Worth Keeping
mmwiki-lv.kind: Fan database of vendor values, built from players' vendor ledgers
mmwiki-lv.freshness: Live database; values quoted here were pulled Oct 18, 2026 (ledgers may predate the Oct 15 coin patch)
mmwiki-lv.auto: Not by scraping: the site's copyright page forbids automated collection and copying large parts. Its Partner API (key from a wiki Site Admin) returns vendorPays per item for lookups, 120 calls/min, attribution required, no wholesale mirroring.
mmwiki-lv.reliability: Medium: real ledger data, per-item, but sample size per item is not shown
mmwiki-lv.label: FACT

mmwiki-api.name: monstersandmemories.wiki Partner API (vendorPays)
mmwiki-api.auto: Yes with a key: tools/prices_update.py --wiki-refresh reads MNM_WIKI_PARTNER_KEY. No key configured yet.
mmwiki-api.reliability: Medium (same ledger data as Loot Worth Keeping)
mmwiki-api.label: FACT

miraheze.name: Monsters and Memories Wiki (Miraheze) item pages
miraheze.freshness: Per page; only 2 of 3,467 items in this Codex's Oct 11 wiki pull have a value
miraheze.auto: Already pulled by the existing wiki tools (MediaWiki API), but almost no data
miraheze.reliability: Low to medium: sparse, some values are from before Early Access
miraheze.label: FACT

official.name: Official patch notes
official.kind: Developer statements on pricing (scrolls, coin drops); no item price lists
official.auto: Patch notes are already tracked by the news/patch tools; they contain no machine-readable prices
official.reliability: High for what they say, but they rarely give numbers
official.label: FACT

tunnel.name: The Tunnel (thetunnel.xyz)
tunnel.kind: Unofficial player marketplace: buy/sell listings (asking prices, expire after 7 days) and anonymous 'log a sale' reports
tunnel.freshness: Live, but thin: 18 open listings and 3 logged sales across all servers when checked Oct 18, 2026
tunnel.auto: No. There is no documented API or terms for reuse, and the site's own listing feed also returns posters' IP addresses and PINs, so this Codex will not pull it automatically. Rows here were copied by hand (item, price, server, date only).
tunnel.reliability: Low: asking prices from single players, not completed sales; tiny sample
tunnel.label: UNVERIFIED
